scope: Local controlled production login, 5 cold contexts, Chromium 156, 1365x900, 4x CPU, 40ms latency, 1.6Mbps down, gzip HTTP, fixed branding fixture
decision: Freeze from baseline plus the diagnostic build: require at least 18.4% total transfer reduction, 20% encoded-body reduction, median LCP within baseline+5%, and controlled interaction max <=100ms. The original 20% total-transfer candidate is not a guaranteed result. Timing budgets are local lab regression limits, not production SLOs or field INP. Final confirmation must run without competing validation workloads.
